## Competence / SOTA check

Which domain, method, project, technical or interface competencies were material? Was current SOTA/best practice needed, and why is the chosen option a fit here?

## Assurance

- [ ] Deterministic validation/tests pass.
- [ ] New hard rules have regression coverage.
- [ ] Derived state is reproducible.
- [ ] AI-generated judgement remains candidate unless proper authority accepts it.
- [ ] Human-readable explanation states what changed, why, evidence/assumptions, consequences and remaining uncertainty.

## Human decision needed

State only the judgement/authority that cannot be automated. If none: `none`.
